admin_bootstrap_readback_approved.description: True only after the privileged Cloud SQL role bootstrap readback passes.

alert_notification_channel_ids.description: Verified Monitoring notification channels for runtime alerts.

allow_google_workspace_aal1_privileged.description: Production residual-risk exception. Must not be true without explicit DEV-032 approval.

application_image.description: Immutable AI_PDM production image reference. Tags and source deployment are forbidden.

billing_account_id.description: Approved billing account. Placeholder until production target is authorized.

billing_budget_currency_code.description: Cloud Billing account currency. The approved account is denominated in TWD.

billing_budget_units.description: TWD 9,600 operational budget, preserving the approved USD 300 monthly cap contract.

budget_notification_channel_ids.description: Verified Monitoring notification channels for 50/80/100 budget alerts.

clean_seed_allowlist_approved.description: True only after clean seed, non-reuse reservation and named canary allowlist evidence is approved.

cloud_sql_proxy_image.description: Digest-pinned Cloud SQL Auth Proxy v2 image.

database_tier.description: Initial production Cloud SQL tier; right-size by reviewed plan and measured run-rate.

enable_migration_runner_job.description: Creates the private DEV-032 production migration Job. The Job remains dry-run unless live execution is separately enabled.

enable_resource_creation.description: DEV-032 production resource creation gate. Defaults false. A plan is not apply approval.

estimated_monthly_cost_usd.description: Operator-supplied cost estimate from the credentialled plan. Defaults zero for static review only.

firebase_auth_domain.description: Production Firebase Auth handler domain; this is not the application gateway.

firebase_web_api_key.description: Restricted public Firebase Web API key for production.

firebase_web_app_id.description: Firebase Web app ID for production.

hd84_restore_reconciliation_approved.description: True only after HD-8-4 / 1A separate-target restore and numbering-ledger reconciliation pass.

level3_smoke_plan_approved.description: True only after the production-like Level 3 smoke plan and operator are approved.

migration_live_execution.description: Switches the migration Job from dry-run to live execution. Requires a separate exact acknowledgement and completed admin bootstrap.

migration_live_execution_acknowledgement.description: Exact acknowledgement required before Terraform may configure the migration Job for live execution.

migration_runner_image.description: Immutable DEV-032 production migration-runner image. Tags and source deployment are forbidden.

migration_runner_job_acknowledgement.description: Exact acknowledgement required before the production migration Job can be created.

migration_runner_source_revision.description: Exact Git source revision embedded in the migration runner image.

principal_bootstrap_execution.description: Switches the private migration Job to the production principal bootstrap runner.

principal_bootstrap_execution_acknowledg.description: Exact acknowledgement required before the production principal bootstrap runner may execute.

principal_bootstrap_readback_approved.description: True only after the production principal bootstrap readback proves one active admin and the expected role/permission seed.

production_apply_acknowledgement.description: Exact acknowledgement required before any resource can be planned for creation.

production_domain.description: Production custom domain behind the external Application Load Balancer.

production_env_source_approved.description: True only after production public/runtime env source is reviewed without exposing secret values.

production_principal_firebase_uid.description: Verified production Firebase UID for the initial admin. A template or staging UID is forbidden.

production_project_number.description: Immutable Google Cloud project number used by billing-budget filters and readback.

production_secret_metadata_readback_appr.description: True only after required Secret Manager metadata IDs are readable. Secret values are never read by this package.

production_target_readback_approved.description: True only after read-only production project, Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, Firebase and Secret Manager target readback is approved.

reconciliation_execution.description: Switches the private migration Job to the read-only DEV-032 production/restore reconciliation runner.

reconciliation_execution_acknowledgement.description: Exact acknowledgement required before the read-only reconciliation runner may execute.

reconciliation_mode.description: Read-only reconciliation mode: pre_canary, post_smoke or restore.

reconciliation_restore_connection_name.description: Independent restore-target Cloud SQL connection name. Empty outside restore mode.

restore_target_readback_approved.description: True only after the isolated restore target exists and its project, region and connection name are read back.

rollback_readiness_approved.description: True only after Cloud Run, database and operator rollback readiness are approved.

schema_migration_readback_approved.description: True only after the production schema migration and immediate idempotent rerun readback pass.

session_audience.description: Audience embedded in PDM BFF session v2 tokens.

session_current_key_id.description: Non-secret identifier for the active session-signing key.

session_issuer.description: Issuer embedded in PDM BFF session v2 tokens.

session_previous_key_id.description: Non-secret identifier retained for verification during signing-key rotation.

trust_google_workspace_mfa.description: Production must either approve AAL1 residual risk or provide Workspace 2SV/provider-managed MFA evidence.
